purpose: Interactive requirements workflow that writes a draft first and refines it through dialogue with the user when no Figma or screen design exists, for new apps or added features.
summary: Lists required reading and a six-phase flow with a loop back when the type changes
Phase 0 confirms what the prior discussion established and judges whether the project is entirely new
Phase 1 fetches rules and existing assets, the latter only when not entirely new
Phase 2 confirms vision, value, scope, and constraints
Phase 3 judges pure-additive versus differential type, decides placement, assigns IDs, and writes the draft
Phase 4 refines via discussion: scenarios, glossary, bottom-up exploration order, requirements, and temporary marker
Phase 5 covers quality checks, TBD cleanup, AI review, specs update, commit, and completion guidance
Defines dialogue principles, anti-patterns, special rules for ambiguity and TBD, and question templates
tasks: Starting a new application from scratch
Adding a feature to an existing application
Judging pure-additive versus differential development type
Reviewing requirements with TBD and ambiguity rules
Drafting a requirements document before discussion
title: 対話型要件定義ワークフロー
